_: Formats over the one-third cap today, per campaign, as "<FORMAT> <count>".
The rule and the conversion policy are in DIVERSITY_PASS.md. Three properties:
a campaign over the cap and not listed here fails immediately; a row whose
campaign is now inside the cap fails, naming the line to delete; and a row whose
count has moved in either direction fails, naming the new number — because a
count that has improved and not been recorded reads exactly like a count nobody
has touched, and this pass converts stops a handful at a time. It only shrinks.
